Author: bdg
Name: Excess Entrust
Punchline: Entrust excess materials to your themed retainers, keeping what your Artisan list needs.
Description: With the summoning bell's retainer list open, /excess walks every retainer that has an AutoRetainer entrust plan and hands over the excess of each plan's items and categories - while keeping enough in your bags to cover the materials of a selected Artisan crafting list. '/excess list <name>' picks the list, '/excess none' clears it, '/excess stop' aborts.
